source: LinkedIn public pages (no login), read with curl and a desktop browser User-Agent; discovery via web search restricted to linkedin.com

schema_notes.date: Event date for results and race recaps (post date kept in post_date); post date for announcements, milestones and other posts. Event dates not stated in a post come from docs/EVENTS_VERIFICATION.md and are named in notes.
schema_notes.embed_urn: The post's own share or ugcPost URN read from the page's main article (data-attributed-urn). embed_src is the matching LinkedInEmbed frame URL. Pulse articles cannot be embedded (null).
schema_notes.image_urls: Public media.licdn.com URLs from the post's structured data (video posts: the video cover). Nothing is downloaded; permission is needed before any image is copied into the repo.
schema_notes.priority: A = lead item for the period, B = good supporting item, C = filler or context.
schema_notes.facts: Each fact with where it appears (text, poster, image card, photo n).

candidates.title: The F1/10 racing simulator goes open source

candidates.excerpt: Felix Jahncke, Moritz Wagner and Johannes Betz at TUM published an open repository that adds a Livox MID-360 3D LiDAR and a working SLAM pipeline to the car with a single install command. It includes drivers, a mount CAD file, demo videos and ROS bags.

candidates.title: A new non-profit for autonomous vehicle education: Neobotics Foundation
